name: Eglon
overview: The name Eglon appears in Scripture both as a king of Moab and as a city within the land of Canaan. Eglon the Moabite king was empowered by the Lord to oppress Israel due to their disobedience, illustrating God's sovereign judgment (Judges 3:12). Additionally, Eglon is identified as one of the cities captured by Joshua during Israel's conquest, later allotted to the tribe of Judah, highlighting God's faithfulness in giving the promised land to His people (Joshua 10:23, 10:35, 15:39).
